journey.name: edit the pubky.app profile
journey.description: Precondition: a disposable wallet signed in to a Pubky profile, PIN off and an English device. This checks that Edit Profile presents the profile as the user's public pubky.app profile and that a name change is saved and shown again after a relaunch. Whether the change also reached pubky.app is checked outside the app, under the PR's manual tests.

actions.action: Open Profile using "ProfileButton" and wait for "ProfileViewName"
Verify the footer note says this is your pubky.app profile and that it is public
Replace the name with "Edited In Bitkit" and dismiss the keyboard
Relaunch the app, open Profile using "ProfileButton" and wait for the full profile name (id "ProfileViewName", predicate exists)
